groups.add.description: Puts a viewer in a group, like "Giveaway". The group is made when it does not exist yet. Leave the user out for the person who triggered the action.

parameters.platform: Optional. The platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.user: Optional. The user name, like "CoolViewer42" (a leading @ is fine). Leave it out for the user of the trigger.
parameters.userId: Optional. The user's id on that platform. Leave it out for the id of the trigger's user.

groups.add.returns: true when added, false when they were already in it.

groups.clear.description: Takes every viewer out of a group. The group itself stays.
groups.clear.returns: How many viewers were removed, or -1 when there is no such group.

groups.contains.description: Checks whether a viewer is in a group. Matches by user id when both have one, otherwise by name.

parameters.platform: Optional. The platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.user: Optional. The user name, like "CoolViewer42" (a leading @ is fine). Leave it out for the user of the trigger.
parameters.userId: Optional. The user's id on that platform. Leave it out for the id of the trigger's user.

groups.contains.returns: true when they are in the group, otherwise false.

groups.create.returns: true when it was made, false when a group with that name already exists.

groups.delete.description: Deletes a group and its member list.
groups.delete.returns: true when it was deleted, false when there was no such group.

groups.exists.description: Checks whether a group with this name exists.
groups.exists.returns: true when it exists, otherwise false.

groups.list.description: Lists the names of all your groups.
groups.list.returns: A list of group names, like ["Giveaway", "Regulars"].

groups.remove.description: Takes a viewer out of a group. Leave the user out for the person who triggered the action.

parameters.platform: Optional. The platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.user: Optional. The user name, like "CoolViewer42" (a leading @ is fine). Leave it out for the user of the trigger.
parameters.userId: Optional. The user's id on that platform. Leave it out for the id of the trigger's user.

groups.remove.returns: true when removed, false when they were not in it.

groups.users.description: Lists the viewers in a group.
groups.users.returns: A list of members, each with platform, userId and userName. Empty when the group does not exist.
